how-it-works-subtitle: In less than 1 minute you're already talking to someone from around the world.
how-it-works-step-one-desc: Sign up for free with email or Google. No credit card needed.
how-it-works-step-two-desc: Choose the language and interest. Live rooms are waiting for you right now.
how-it-works-step-three-desc: Turn on your mic, introduce yourself, and practice with real people live.
button-news: Stay up to date with the latest news
site-header-start-three: The only app where you study vocabulary with AI and join live rooms to practice — all in one place. No competitor does both.
features-title: Learn + Practice — all in one app
features-title-detail: No competitor does both. Safe 4 Talk combines gamified study with live practice with real people.
features-button-one-details: Study every day, don't break the chain. The longer your streak, the stronger the motivation — and the fear of losing it.
features-button-two-details: Jump into audio and video rooms in seconds. Practice what you just learned with real people right now.
features-button-three-details: Spaced Repetition SM-2: the app knows exactly when to review each word so you never forget.
features-button-four-details: Speak a word or phrase. AI analyzes your audio, gives a 0–100% score and pinpoints the wrong phoneme.
features-button-five-details: Hosts monetize paid rooms, earn live tips and build their audience inside the app.
features-button-six-details: Rooms segmented by language and level. People from every country ready to talk right now.

data-deletion-intro: Safe4Talk values your privacy. In compliance with Facebook Platform policies, Google API Services User Data Policy, GDPR, and LGPD, we provide the following instructions on how to request the deletion of your data.
data-deletion-form-intro: The fastest way to delete your data is using the automated form below. Enter the email linked to your account:
data-deletion-alt-intro: Alternatively, you can request data deletion via email. If you signed up or logged in using Facebook Login or Google Login:
data-deletion-request-p1: If you signed up or logged in using Facebook Login or Google Login and wish to remove your data associated with Safe4Talk, please follow these steps:
data-deletion-request-li1: Send an email to our Data Protection Team at privacy@safe4talk.com.
data-deletion-request-li2: Use the subject line: Data Deletion Request.
data-deletion-request-li3: In the email body, please include your full name and specify that your account is linked via Facebook or Google Login.
data-deletion-facebook-p2: Alternatively, you may remove the app permissions directly through Facebook:
data-deletion-facebook-li1: Go to your Facebook Account Settings & Privacy > Settings.
data-deletion-facebook-li3: Find Safe4Talk in the list of active apps.
data-deletion-note: Note: Once we receive your request via email or a revocation notification from Facebook or Google, we will initiate the data deletion process.
data-deletion-types-p1: Upon your request, the following data will be permanently removed/anonymized:
data-deletion-types-li1: Profile information (Name, Email Address, Profile Picture).
data-deletion-types-li2: Social Provider User IDs (Facebook/Google) and authentication tokens.
data-deletion-types-li3: Any application-specific preferences stored purely for your user session.
data-deletion-timeframe-p1: Your data will be completely deleted from our systems within 30 days of the request verification.
privacy-intro: Your privacy matters to us. This Privacy Policy describes how Safe 4 Talk collects, uses and protects the information of users who use our language practice application.
privacy-s1-2-li1: App usage data (frequency, session duration, feedback)
privacy-s2-li1: Provide personalized pairings based on language and level
privacy-s2-li2: Improve the quality of interactions and calls
privacy-s2-li4: Make performance and user experience improvements
privacy-s2-li5: Ensure compliance with our Terms of Use
privacy-s3-intro: We do not sell your personal information. We may share it only when:
privacy-s3-li1: Required by law or competent authorities
privacy-s3-li2: Necessary to prevent fraud, abuse or threats
privacy-s3-li3: For third-party services that help us operate the platform (such as hosting or data analytics services), always under confidentiality agreements
privacy-s4-text: We store your information on secure servers with encryption protocols and access controls. We apply technical and organizational measures to protect your data.
privacy-s5-li3: Request deletion of your account and data
privacy-s5-contact: To exercise your rights, contact us:
privacy-s6-text: Safe 4 Talk is intended for users aged 13 and over. If we identify use by minors without parental consent, their data will be removed.
privacy-s7-text: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. We will notify you through the app or your registered email.
